## Chestnut Cabin

Pigeon Forge, TN, United States



16 guests

6 bedrooms

6.5 bathrooms

Welcome to Chestnut Cabin, your action-packed Smoky Mountain getaway in beautiful Pigeon Forge, Tennessee! This spacious 6-bedroom cabin was made for unforgettable family vacations and memory-making in the mountains. From breathtaking mountain views and spectacular sunsets to a private hot tub, outdoor bowling alley, arcade-packed game room, immersive gaming den, private theater, and one-of-a-kind bunk room with its own slide, Chestnut Cabin brings the fun of a family resort right to your cabin.

### Good to know

We’re thrilled to welcome you to Chestnut Cabin, one of the newest additions to our collection! With years of experience hosting guests in the Smokies and over 2,000+ 5-star reviews across our properties, we’re committed to providing an exceptional stay. While this is a new account for properties we manage on behalf of friends and family, rest assured that your experience will be nothing short of spectacular.

Chestnut Cabin was made for family fun and unforgettable mountain memories! Gather together in the spacious living room with soaring wood ceilings and a cozy stone fireplace, then let the fun begin. Challenge the family in the arcade-packed game room with pool, shuffleboard, darts, Mortal Kombat, Ms. Pac-Man, a driving game, and more, or head downstairs to the Gaming Den with two Xbox systems. Movie nights get even better in your private theater with reclining seating, while the kids will love their one-of-a-kind mountain-themed bunk room featuring its very own tube slide!

The fun continues outside with an amenity you definitely don't find at every mountain cabin: your own private outdoor bowling lane! See who can bowl the first strike, then unwind together in the private hot tub or find your favorite spot on one of the multiple decks to enjoy the fresh mountain air and beautiful Smoky Mountain scenery. Whether your perfect family vacation includes arcade battles, Xbox tournaments, outdoor bowling competitions, movie marathons, racing down the bunk-room slide, soaking in the hot tub, or simply spending time together around the fireplace, Chestnut Cabin gives you countless ways to make memories without ever leaving the property.

At Chestnut Cabin, you’re not simply booking a place to stay, you’re giving the whole family a Smoky Mountain vacation they’ll be talking about long after they head home!

KITCHEN -
The kitchen is designed to make cooking for a crowd easy and enjoyable. Featuring granite countertops, a spacious kitchen island, stainless steel appliances, ample counter space, and a fully stocked kitchen with cooking essentials, you'll have everything you need for family breakfasts, home-cooked dinners, and late-night snacks. Coffee lovers can choose between a Keurig and a traditional drip coffee maker to get each morning started right. The open-concept design connects the kitchen directly to the dining and living spaces, so whoever is cooking can still be part of the fun. The large dining table offers seating for 8, with 2 additional seats at the kitchen island and another 3 at the high-top behind the couch, creating plenty of options for your group to gather together.

OUTDOOR AREAS AND DECKS-
The outdoor spaces at Chestnut Cabin are every bit as fun as the inside! Multiple levels of decks offer outdoor chairs and side tables where you can relax, enjoy the fresh mountain air, and take in the beautiful surrounding scenery and sunsets. On the lower deck, soak your cares away in the private hot tub after a full day exploring the Smokies. Then challenge the family to something you don't find at your average mountain cabin: your own outdoor bowling lane! Set up the pins, grab a bowling ball, and see who earns bragging rights for the vacation. A gas grill is also available for cookouts, while the various decks provide plenty of places to slow down and enjoy your time in the mountains.

RECREATION AREA -
Chestnut Cabin takes family entertainment seriously! The loft game room is packed with activities, including a pool table, shuffleboard, dart board, Mortal Kombat, Ms. Pac-Man, a multicade arcade system, and a driving arcade game. With its colorful arcade atmosphere and wide variety of games, everyone can find something to play. Downstairs, the separate Gaming Den offers a completely different experience with two Xbox systems, cozy seating, and vibrant retro video-game murals. It's a fun space for kids and teens, and probably more than a few adults, to hang out and game. When it's time to wind down, head to the private theater room and settle into the reclining theater seating for movie night. Custom murals, classic-car décor, and twinkling lights transform the space into your own private cinema. And don't forget the outdoor entertainment! The lower deck features a private bowling lane, giving your group another unique way to play while enjoying the mountain setting.

They are designed so that you are all set when you arrive, but not to last the entire trip.
• Less than 8 miles from downtown Gatlinburg, with access to all the area has to offer, which includes its great restaurants, shopping & Smoky Mountain National Park.

• Our proximity to the Great Smoky Mountain National Park means there is lots of wildlife in our area - black bears, deer, wild turkeys, raccoons, coyotes, foxes, and more! Black bears visit the cabin often in Spring, Summer, and Fall. You may get lucky and catch a glimpse of one of these residents while enjoying the view from the deck. We also contract regular monthly pest services, which treat all pests, including multiple types of bugs, mice, etc. Despite our regular treatments, given the proximity of the cabin to the park, it is possible these pests can temporarily enter the cabin. • Linens (bedding, towels, etc.) – removed & washed offsite in temperatures exceeding those recommended for laundry operations, then packaged until the housekeeping staff is ready to put them out for guests.
• Hot Tub -- Drained, cleaned, fresh Bromine added, and refilled after every guest
• The cabin is inspected regularly after cleaning, and inspectors perform additional applications of protective products in the cabin, such as MicroBan and Lysol.
• Cleaning staff received additional education on disinfection protocols and are furnished with protective gloves, changing them for fresh pairs as needed during cleaning & disinfection of the home.

Welcome to Sherwood Forest Resort, one of Pigeon Forge's premier gated mountain communities!

Nestled in the heart of the Smokies, Sherwood Forest offers the perfect blend of peaceful mountain living and convenient access to all the area's top attractions. You're just minutes from Dollywood, The Island, dinner shows, shopping, restaurants, and Great Smoky Mountains National Park, making it an ideal home base for your Smoky Mountain getaway.

During your stay, you'll enjoy access to the resort's seasonal outdoor swimming pool, beautifully maintained paved roads, gated entrance, street lighting, and breathtaking mountain scenery. The spacious kitchen at White Pine makes preparing meals and gathering together effortless. Featuring modern appliances, a large kitchen island, and plenty of room to prepare everything from a quick breakfast to a family dinner, the kitchen is designed with larger groups in mind. The open-concept layout flows seamlessly into the dining and living areas, allowing everyone to stay connected whether you're cooking, relaxing by the fireplace, or planning the day's Smoky Mountain adventures.

The large dining table offers seating for 10, with an additional 3 seats at the kitchen island and 3 more at the high-top table behind the couch, providing plenty of room for meals, games, and time together.

SPACIOUS OUTDOOR DECKS-

The main-level deck features a comfortable sectional couch and rocking chairs, making it a wonderful place to enjoy your morning coffee, catch up with family, or simply slow down and take in the fresh mountain air.

Head to the lower deck for even more fun and relaxation, where you'll find a private hot tub, two hanging swings, and outdoor bowling complete with a custom mural. ## The Vision Cabin

Pigeon Forge, TN, United States



6 guests

2 bedrooms

1.5 bathrooms

Our 2-bed, 1.5-bath cabin provides unparalleled, stunning views of the Smoky Mountains, surrounded by over 3000 acres of beautiful forest with direct access to walking trails to enjoy everything the forest has to offer! Breathe in the serenity of the forest, soak in the hot tub with unobstructed views & experience staying in a "treehouse like" cabin only 9 miles from Pigeon Forge, nestled in the Tennessee Foothills Conservancy! The 2 story cabin sleeps 6 & is perfect for a relaxing get away!

### Good to know

This cabin features an outdoor paradise!!!! Amazing views from everywhere outside. 2 decks for you to enjoy hanging out on looking out at the mountains, and a hot tub, with picture perfect view!! Not only does this cabin offer these amazing views, it also gives you access to a hiking trail right in your backyard, and a playhouse for the kids!

We are so excited for the opportunity to host you at the cabin. We have been hosting groups in the Smokies at our cabins for years with over 1000+ 5 star reviews and happy guests! You may not see it on this account, as this is our new account for properties we are managing for other owners.

Backyard:
• Private, surrounded by beautiful forest!
• Walking trail access directly off the backyard
• Breathtaking views!!

LIVING ROOM –The living room features real wood walls and high vaulted ceilings. This cozy space features comfy furniture surrounding the wood burning fireplace, and TV for a cozy night in binge watching shows.

BEDROOMS
The cabin sleeps up to 6 guests with 2 bedrooms and a queen mattress pull out sofa in the living room. The primary bedroom is on the first floor featuring an ensuite bathroom.

Main floor (sleeps 4 people):
• Primary Bedroom- King Bedroom with ensuite bathroom and TV.
• Living Room- Queen Size pull out sofa.

2nd floor (sleeps 2 people):
• 2nd Bedroom- Queen Bedroom in a loft area with a private nook, and half bath.

DECKS - 2 decks off the back of the cabin! With ample seating, including rocking chairs and a porch swing. A hot tub, with an amazing view of the mountains, as well as a child's "treehouse" style play area, and gas BBQ grill.

DINING ROOM – Open to the main floor with a table for four, as well as seating at the kitchen bar.

KITCHEN – Well-appointed with all the major utensils, silverware, dishes, glasses and cookware needed for you to create & serve gourmet meals. Electric stove, oven, microwave, refrigerator, dishwasher, coffee maker, etc. Even includes a dry bar for your cocktails or mocktails.

ADDITIONAL AMENITIES –
• High Speed Internet
• Full size washer and dryer
• Convenient access to Downtown Pigeon Forge, only 9 miles away!
• Only 13 miles away from the entrance to Dollywood/Splash Country!
• Convenient paved parking with plenty of space for 3 standard size SUVs. No RV or trailer parking permitted.
• Heating & A/C
• Gas BBQ grill
• We provide a set of starter supplies to allow you to get settled when you arrive. They include 2 trash bags, 2 dishwasher pods, a paper towel roll, a small liquid dish soap bottle, a toilet paper, a small bottle of shampoo, body lotion, body wash, conditioner and a soap bar for each bathroom, towels, bed linens, as well as a basic kitchen supplies. They are designed so that you are all set when you arrive but not to last the entire trip
• Our close proximity to the Great Smoky Mountain National Park means there is lots of wildlife in our area - black bears, deer, wild turkeys, raccoons, coyotes, fox, and more! Black bears visit the cabin often in Spring, Summer and Fall. You may get lucky and catch a glimpse of one of these residents while enjoying the view from the deck. We also contract regular monthly pest services which treat for all pests from multiple types of bugs, mice, etc. Despite our regular treatments, given the proximity of the cabin to the park, it is possible these pests can temporarily enter the cabin. We immediately respond and treat if anything comes up and have found it is rare to come across anything like this.

### Other Details to Note

We continue to taking extra precautions to ensure extra cleanliness and prioritize guest safety:

• All hard & soft surfaces cleaned with Micro-Ban™ including: counters, vanities, sinks, floors, stair rails, cabinets, doors, furniture, beds, pillows, carpets, comforters, etc. throughout cabin.
• Lysol™ is used thoroughly on all compatible surfaces to clean and disinfect
• Bleach-based cleaners used in all bathrooms and kitchens, that allow use of chlorine products.
• Linens (bedding, towels, etc) – removed & washed offsite in temperatures exceeding those recommended for laundry operations, then packaged until the housekeeping staff are ready to put them out for guests.
• Hot Tub -- Drained, cleaned, fresh Bromine added and refilled after every guest
• Cabin inspected regularly after cleaning and inspectors perform additional applications of protective products in the cabin, such as MicroBan and Lysol.
• Cleaning staff received additional education on disinfection protocols and are furnished with protective gloves, changing them for fresh pairs as needed during cleaning & disinfection of the home.

The serene cabin is only 9 miles from Pigeon Forge and nestled in the Tennessee Foothills Conservancy! This area provides fantastic privacy and the feeling of being nestled in a treehouse in the woods with just a handful of other cabins in this cozy community with unparalleled views.

It is very rare to find a cabin with this kind of unobstructed view of the mountains and valleys of the Smokies. It is like living in an iconic postcard. It gives you a true feeling of serenity in the mountains, a peaceful setting to unplug and enjoy real mountain living. In order to get this balance of serenity and still close proximity to Pigeon Forge, you will need to navigate up steep and windy Smoky Mountain roads. Like most other roads through the Smokies, we would advise all-wheel or 4-wheel drive vehicles to provide a smooth trip up the one-way road to the cabin.
